speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in. Shut the door. The close is cold, which I can say without having been anywhere but here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The door is shut. I am not bringing the yard in with me. You asked for no title at noon. You still do not have one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is a smear by your ear. I am saying it once, in this passage, and not at the table. The basin is at the turn. The water is cold, as it was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard you. I will take the cold water, and I will come down with my own face. The coat can go on the peg. The stitch held.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Supper is broth, and the crabs that were already ours. I have lit the hall. I am not lighting a second candle for a story. Have you one?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have none for this house. I will wash, and I will sit, and I will eat what you have. The day can stay in the coat until the coat is on the peg.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is by the fire. He did not go up to the book. I looked, because of the bundle. It is as you left it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it as I left it. I am not a man arriving with news. Wash first. Then the bowl.
